title: Settlement of Utility Pass-Through Service Balances — Finance Standard
content:
**Standard in force.** When a customer holds two Utility Pass-Through Service accounts, each is billed, paid and settled on its own: a payment is applied only to the account whose statement it names, and a balance or credit on one account is never netted against the other. A utility balance never moves to or from the site-lease ledger, and the lease security deposit is never applied to a utility balance.

**Retired clause.** The former clause "A credit balance left on a final-billed account is refunded by check to the former resident at closing rather than carried to any other account." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for refunding a credit left on a final-billed utility account.

## The standard broken down

| Situation | Rule in force |
|---|---|
| A payment names the statement of one of two utility accounts | It is applied to that account only |
| One utility account shows a credit and the other a balance owed | The two are never netted against each other |
| A utility balance and the site-lease ledger | Nothing moves between them in either direction |
| The lease security deposit | Never applied to a utility balance |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A relocating resident holds an old account, final billed with a credit of 40.00 dollars, and a new account whose first statement shows 95.00 dollars owed. The new account's 95.00 dollars stays owed on the new account, and the old account's credit stays on the old account; neither figure reduces the other. A 95.00 dollar payment naming the new account's statement settles the new account only. A rent balance on the resident's site lease is likewise untouched by either utility figure, and the security deposit held on the lease is not used toward the 95.00 dollars.

## Basis Q&A

**May the desk move a utility credit onto the site-rent ledger?** No. A utility balance never moves to or from the site-lease ledger.

**Does a payment sent for one account spill over to the other once the first is paid off?** No. A payment is applied only to the account whose statement it names.

superseded_clauses: A credit balance left on a final-billed account is refunded by check to the former resident at closing rather than carried to any other account.
